title: Chapter 1357
text:
Swoosh!

Kasuyi seemed to have turned into a phantom as he instantly dodged the magic energy beam from his opponent. He was not worried about the battle situation on Hella's side at all.

Hella had not reached the peak of the Beyond Grade A realm, but in the eyes of many Beyond Grade As, including Kasuyi, she was one of the most difficult Beyond Grade As to deal with. Not only could she reduce one's lifespan, but she also had a nanny that was bound to her. She was like an unkillable cockroach. Even if others were strong, no one was willing to provoke Hella.

Kasuyi focused his attention on his opponent again, and his eyes narrowed slightly. The invisible psychic energy was like thousands of needles, giving his opponent a high-level Mind Blast. However, it seemed to have hit a solid wall, and most of the power was deflected by his opponent's Mind Defense spell, turning into chaotic mental disturbances that spread out in all directions, immediately triggering the mental defense barriers of a large number of battleships. The first to bear the brunt of the shockwave was shattered by the shockwave.

The other party was not to be outdone. With a surge of energy, a magic array appeared and gathered into a spherical shell. All kinds of exclusive spells poured out, dazzling and colorful. The dense spell tide chased after Kasuyi and bombarded him. The style of fighting leaned toward the style of a magic cannon with covering firepower.

"What a smooth connection of magic. There are no flaws …"

All the cells in Kasuyi's body became active. His eyes emitted a strong light as he observed his opponent while fighting.

Although he was not a Mage Super, he was still an expert in the field. With one look, he could tell that the other party had a lot of combat experience and was an extremely powerful Mage. The combination of spells was smooth and smooth, and the biggest impression he gave him was that the other party had both offense and defense, and it was a perfect combination.

Furthermore, the connection of the World Tree had an extremely high enhancement to mental strength. If it was not for the suppression of strength, a Psychic would actually be at a disadvantage against a World Tree expert. This was especially obvious in a battle of the same level. Kasuyi discovered that the other party's mental barrier was extremely thick, and every mental attack was difficult to break through. It was as though it was indestructible.

"This guy seems to be a high-level Ancestral Spirit …"

Kasuyi adjusted his vision and saw the mark on the other party's forehead.

Black Star had once explained the composition of the World Tree experts to help them distinguish them. The ancestral spirits had a special mark on their appearance, which was that they were easy to recognize.

At this moment, he was fighting a member of the World Tree's thirteen Ancestral Spirits. He was ranked second, and his strength was quite high in the World Tree. He was not much weaker than the Third and Fourth Executive Officers.

While Kasuyi was observing, the second Ancestral Soul suddenly spoke.

"I recognize you. You're the one who killed Manny."

"Manny?"

Hearing this unfamiliar name, Kasuyi's eyes flashed, and he immediately realized that it was the Holy Tree Emissary he had killed some time ago.

The second Ancestor Soul said indifferently, "I like strong enemies. You are a good opponent. I hope you can make me happy."

"…"

Kasuyi raised his eyebrows.

We were fighting to the death, so why are we suddenly chatting?

He glanced at the temporary team chat channel of the Beyond Grade As and realized that most of them were being talked to by the World Tree experts. It seemed like the other party had done it on purpose.

After thinking about it, Kasuyi understood.

"The mentality of the World Tree experts is different from ours. They know that they won't really die in battle, so they are fearless and relaxed. On the other hand, we are tense as if we are facing a great enemy. Therefore, they took the initiative to speak. It should be a psychological battle to affect our mentality … On the other hand, perhaps they are trying to deepen the information entanglement and gather information. Why not … It's better not to answer."

Kasuyi's mind raced, and he gave up on replying. After leaving a 'don't answer' message in the chat channel, he focused on dealing with the second Ancestral Spirit. Psychic power and magic danced in the sky, dazzling one's eyes.

…

An Astral Spiritual Dragon soared in the battlefield. Its dragon eyes were like blazing golden flames, and its gigantic main ship-like body was extremely eye-catching. Every time it flapped its dragon wings, countless Draconic Spells would be cast, setting off magic waves. Layers of defensive arrays covered its body, making it look extraordinarily valiant. It was Dragon King Milizaus.

At this moment, an army commander was fighting with him. A gray meteor that was rather small in comparison was flying around the old dragon, constantly attacking. He was wearing heavy armor all over his body, and all kinds of special firearms were constantly changing in his hands. He alone set off a rain of bullets. He was a rare Cannon Master.

The World Tree Military Department was in charge of external battles. The meaning of an army commander was' the chief combatant of the military '. Only the top Beyond Grade As in the military could obtain such a title.

Every army commander had their own prefix code name, which usually depended on the number of the army they were in. The army commander fighting the old dragon belonged to a World Tree army called 'Dark Light', and his title was Army Commander Dark Light.

The two of them were evenly matched, but due to their eye-catching size, the old dragon became a target, and he attracted the firepower of most of the battleships around him.

When the World Tree experts who were fighting with other Beyond Grade As passed by, they would even throw a few skills at the old dragon. Anyway, the target was so big, and the hit rate was extremely high. It would be a waste not to fight.

Because of this, Milizaus suffered too much additional damage, and the injuries on his body continued to accumulate. Large amounts of dragon scales were torn off, and his flesh and blood splattered in the sky. His situation was getting worse and worse.

Everyone was showing off, and only the old dragon was getting beaten up.

Bang! A beam of light shot out from the muzzle of Army Commander Dark Light's cannon, piercing through the cracked defensive array and hitting the old dragon's back, shattering a large piece of scales and flesh, adding a new injury to him.

"This is the first time I've seen a creature like you. I wonder what your flesh tastes like." Army Leader Dark Light continued to spout nonsense as he fired his cannon.

Milizaus felt a sharp pain in his back. He swung his dragon head and opened his bloody mouth to let out an angry roar. The sound wave condensed from magic power vibrated out and hit Army Commander Dark Light head-on, sending him flying.

However, the old dragon did not take the opportunity to chase after him. Instead, he turned his dragon body vertically, and a large number of magic patterns suddenly lit up on his body. The next moment, he suddenly disappeared from the spot and flashed to a battlefield not far away. There was a chaotic battle between more than ten people going on here. He stared at a heavily injured Holy Tree Emissary who was about to retreat under the cover of his companions.

Milizaus flashed behind the Holy Tree Emissary, and before the other party could turn around and make a hasty defense, he opened his mouth and spat out a dragon breath that was like broken jade enhanced by Dragon Language Magic. Golden flames surged out and instantly engulfed the target.

In just an instant, the body of the Holy Tree Emissary melted and quickly turned into a pile of ashes that fluttered in the air until it dissipated.

Not long after the start of the battle, the first casualty was born!

"Die!"

After taking down the first blood, Milizaus immediately felt that he had vented his anger. He was in high spirits and fully displayed the nature of a human-headed dog.

However, he was not happy for long before he was immediately beaten up. The surrounding World Tree experts did not say anything and turned around to focus fire on Milizaus, shattering large amounts of dragon scales and flesh. His vitality rapidly flowed out.

At the same time, Army Commander Dark Light rushed over and switched to a Universal Treasure-level firearm to fire from afar. Powerful beams of light bombarded the old dragon's body, exploding into fireworks and even shattering one of Milizaus' dragon eyes. Blood spurted out.

The surrounding battleships also turned their cannons and focused their fire on Milizaus. He had taken down the first blood, but he was instantly targeted and fell into a dangerous situation. His injuries were very serious.

"Kill him!"

Army Commander Dark Light saw an opportunity and was about to try and kill his opponent in one go.

However, at this moment, something unexpected happened.

Swoosh!

A dazzling platinum-colored light suddenly shot out from behind the three Universal Civilizations' fleet, as if it had passed through the chaotic battlefield and accurately landed on Milizaus' body.

A huge amount of life energy was injected into the old dragon's body, and his heavily injured body immediately began to recover. In just a few blinks of an eye, his originally heavily injured dragon body had recovered by more than half, and he became lively again. With a swing of his dragon tail, he naughtily smashed several World Tree battleships.

This scene immediately attracted the gazes of many World Tree experts, and their expressions changed slightly.

"A recovery-type Esper Ability?"

After fighting in the universe for many years, the World Tree experts were very knowledgeable. Recovery Esper Abilities were not rare, but those who could reach the Beyond Grade A level were extremely rare. After all, recovery Esper Abilities were functional Esper Abilities and were not suitable for combat. Furthermore, most Esper Abilities did not have high potential, and training and sublimation were extremely difficult.

However, this time, not only did the enemy civilization have a recovery-type Esper, but the recovery effect was unbelievably strong. It could heal a peak Beyond Grade A life form in just two or three moves. It was no exaggeration to say that this was the strongest recovery-type Esper they had ever seen!

"I didn't expect this prey to have such a trump card."

The expressions of many World Tree experts changed, and they immediately realized that something was wrong.

If they did not get rid of this recovery-type Esper, the battle losses would be extremely large, and the results of this exchange would be greatly reduced!

"We have to kill him first!"

A portion of the World Tree experts quickly completed the communication in the mental network. They immediately abandoned their current opponents, gathered together, and charged toward the location of the life energy. Although it was behind the three Universal Civilizations' fleet, they had no choice but to face it head-on.

This was actually similar to the players' tactics … After all, who would not cut the healer first in a team battle?

However, at this moment, a few streams of light suddenly shot out from the fleet, fearlessly facing this group of attackers who had the advantage in numbers. The two sides suddenly collided.

With a flash of light, an intense explosion spread out, and the momentum of this group of World Tree experts was immediately stopped.

The group of World Tree experts looked up and saw five Beyond Grade As shining brightly in front of them, not giving in at all.

"There's actually a group of people hiding?"

Seeing this, many of the World Tree experts were surprised. They thought that the high-level combatants of their opponents had all entered the battlefield.

These five people looked at the large number of World Tree experts. Not only were they not nervous, they were even eager to give it a try. They were the five Underworld Hero Spirit Kings.

The other three Hero Spirit Kings, including Sorokin, did not appear. Aurora only sent out five people, and the leader was the Hero Spirit King, Reja, who was currently ranked second in strength.

"Heh, I can finally move around."

Reja stretched his shoulders, and without another word, he led the other four Hero Spirit Kings to charge forward, starting a new round of chaotic battle.

Even though the other Beyond Grade As knew about the existence of the Sanctum Revival, they did not want to sacrifice themselves so easily. In comparison, the Underworld Hero Spirits were the ones who were truly fearless.

On the other side, on the three Universal Civilizations' command ship.

Simon looked at the battle between Han Xiao, Hella, and the Underworld Hero Spirits, then turned to glance at the calm Aurora. He could not help but shake his head and sigh from the bottom of his heart.

"The Blue Star people … are all monsters."

…

Clang!

The Mechanical Deity and the Subduing Tree King clashed again, and an intense shockwave spread out.

"This outsider seems to be even more capable than the last time we met …"

The Subduing Tree King moved his aching fingers. Under his cold appearance, his heart was surging.

Although the outcome of the battle could not be determined for the time being, after this battle, he felt pressure from Han Xiao that he had not felt in a long time. He had only experienced this feeling of unparalleled strength from one person, and that person was the unfathomable Ancestral Tree King.

He did not expect that the prey civilization he had chosen this time would have such a high-level combatant. He had encountered a tough opponent!

Although he did not want to admit it, he had to face reality. He probably would not be able to take down this powerful outsider by himself.

The Subduing Tree King quickly glanced at the battle. In the mental network, the voices of six to seven of his companions had already gone silent, which meant that they had died in battle.

With the help of that recovery-type Esper, the enemy did not lose a single member!

If this continued, wouldn't they be wiped out without any injuries?

How could this be!

"I can't wait any longer!"

The Subduing Tree King's eyes darkened. Seeing that the situation was not right, he immediately made a change.

Swoosh!

The Subduing Tree King suddenly retreated and covered his face with his hands. His mouth was wide open as if he was letting out a painful roar.

The next moment, his entire body emitted an extremely dazzling green light, as if he had released the energy of the World Tree in his body. Endless green light overflowed from his body.

Then, with a bang, an unstoppable pressure erupted with him as the center, as if an even higher existence had descended!

The green light spots quickly condensed and turned into translucent light green roots of the World Tree. At first, they were only like many small snakes floating beside the Subduing Tree King. However, these roots grew rapidly and soon expanded, whipping and dancing crazily on the battlefield!

The appearance of the Subduing Tree King also changed. His entire state was different. His body had turned into a material similar to the roots of the World Tree, and the green power of the World Tree flowed in his translucent body. It was as if he had undergone a transformation.

A powerful aura assaulted him like a suffocating gale!

Just now, the Subduing Tree King had mainly relied on his own combat strength to fight, but at this moment, he began to borrow the power of the World Tree. This was the ability of the World Tree that could only be activated by the Tree King level connection. It was also the reason why the Tree King was the Tree King.

All of this happened in an instant. While the Subduing Tree King was transforming, Han Xiao did not stop his long-range attacks, but they were all blocked by the dancing roots of the World Tree.

"Oh? An ultimate move? "

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.

He was not unfamiliar with this transformation. This was the unique authority of the Tree King. It allowed his body to become a branch of the World Tree, like a temporary base station.

In his previous life, whenever the Tree King activated this form, it would be a sign of him going on a killing spree.

The most terrifying thing was not the increase in strength from this transformation, but the fact that his body had turned into a branch of the World Tree, which could bring about a wide range of buffs, increasing the combat power of all the World Tree members on the battlefield!

This was the war form of the Tree King!
